summary: Applied all 3 triaged blocking spec-review findings by clarifying audit-only issue-log behavior, severity-based gate verdict aggregation, and shared gate adapter semantics.

items.title: Issue-log audit-only rule omits existing retry-state behavior paths
items.rationale: The spec now moves no-progress rejection state, pass-to-fail flip state, head/worktree hashes, and passed guardrail state into gateImplMemory and the spec-local memory artifact instead of allowing issue-log behavior reads.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints[4], overview.data_flow[3], overview.decisions[7], requirements R7-R9, and acceptance_criteria[4] now name the moved behavior-state fields and audit-only issue-log boundary.

items.title: Observation severity lacks gate verdict aggregation semantics
items.rationale: The spec now defines severity aggregation: blocking observations fail the gate, advisory-only observations pass while remaining visible in NextAction, and zero observations pass with an empty observations array.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow[2], requirements R6, and acceptance_criteria[2] now define verdict aggregation from Observation severity.

items.title: Shared gate parser scope conflicts with gate-impl-only failure modes
items.rationale: The spec now defines the failureMode enum as shared across gate phases, limits direct rich AI Observation output to gate-impl, and requires legacy shared gate evaluations to be adapted at the wire boundary with deterministic failureMode mapping.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow[5], requirements R3, R4, and R11 now cover non-gate-impl NextAction conversion without requiring every phase to emit gate-impl-only Observation JSON directly.
